deposit().details: The depositor must send ETH and approve the matching amount of tokens. One extra wei of tokens is pulled to round the required amount up, so integer truncation can never under-collateralize the pool.

returns.tokensDeposited: The amount of tokens pulled from the depositor.

ethToToken().details: Reserves are read before the incoming ETH is applied, then the curve is used to price the trade.

returns.tokenOutput: The amount of tokens received by the swapper.

init(uint256).details: The initial liquidity provider must approve the DEX to spend the tokens before calling this function.

params.tokens: The amount of tokens to be deposited by the initializer.

returns.initialLiquidity: The amount of liquidity minted for the initializer.

price(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: The fee is applied to the input before the curve is applied, so the fee is never taken out of the output.

params.xInput: The amount of x being swapped in.
params.xReserves: The reserves of x in the pool.
params.yReserves: The reserves of y in the pool.

returns.yOutput: The amount of y that would be received for the given xInput.

tokenToEth(uint256).details: The swapper must approve the DEX to spend `tokenInput` tokens before calling this function.

params.tokenInput: The amount of tokens being swapped in.

returns.ethOutput: The amount of ETH received by the swapper.

params.amount: The amount of LP tokens to burn.

returns.ethAmount: The amount of ETH returned to the liquidity remover.
returns.tokenAmount: The amount of tokens returned to the liquidity remover.

deposit().notice: Adds liquidity to the DEX at the current pool ratio.

init(uint256).notice: Initializes the DEX by setting the initial liquidity to the amount of ETH sent by the initializer.

price(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Calculates the output amount of y for a given input amount of x, using the constant product formula with a 0.3% fee.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Burns LP tokens and returns the proportional share of the pool's ETH and tokens.
